name: SilikOS shell
description: The SilikOS desktop in three looks (silik look): silik (the title bar is the command line, a text rail of keys, a status bar), bar and island (one piece at the bottom, the applications as icons). The port for GNOME Shell 49 (EL 10), made by el10/port_shell.py: docs/EL10.md says what of it has been run.
